mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% signals weak labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is positive but unemployment remains elevated (UNRATE > 7.5%), it indicates a weak labor market recovery, suppressing consumer confidence and equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between PAYEMS growth and UNRATE > 7.5% fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over 20-day windows, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, declining housing starts (HOUST) signal weakening consumer demand and construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 98.5) signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 98.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise but retail sales (RSAFS) decline, it indicates a misalignment in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising HOUST and declining RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over 60-day windows, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals reduced liquidity, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 230 indicates elevated inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
